title: MGAM-FusionNet: A masked reconstruction and multi-scale attention fusion network for small-sample near-infrared spectral quantification of echinacoside in Cistanche deserticola

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《MGAM-FusionNet: A masked reconstruction and multi-scale attention fusion network for small-sample near-infrared spectral quantification of echinacoside in Cistanche deserticola》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】MGAM-FusionNet achieved an R2 of 0.9197 and an RMSE of 0.3291 on the internal validation set.

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】On the external independent test set, it achieved an R2 of 0.8800, an RMSE of 0.4352, and an RPD of 2.8872.

evidence.text: MGAM-FusionNet achieved an R2 of 0.9197 and an RMSE of 0.3291 on the internal validation set.
On the external independent test set, it achieved an R2 of 0.8800, an RMSE of 0.4352, and an RPD of 2.8872.
